decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks have their own web page and fit the firm's established thermoforming portfolio, so the visible commitment and low running cost favour keeping them.
The PETG thermoforming blank is a core consumable with its own page that supports the firm's thermoforming equipment, so dropping it would write off a visible commitment for little gain.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned and carries little public commitment, but it complements the firm's lab material range and still has time to prove itself.
The intraoral contrast spray is presented prominently and supports the announced digital scanning workflows, so it ties into the strategic direction the firm has committed to.
The custom earmold line belongs to the firm's core hearing-care manufacturing, so any weak early results are likely to be read as temporary.
Custom hearing protection uses the same skills and digital production as the core earmold business, so it is cheap to keep while results are attributed to early market development.
